name: xAI Realtime Voice (Discord)
description: Registers Grok Voice Agent (grok-voice-latest) as realtime provider xai-gated for Discord agent-proxy, with local Whisper wake-gating, mic presence management, and a working-on-it audio cue. Provider id is xai-gated because OpenClaw 2026.11+ reserves xai for its bundled voice provider, which refuses agent-proxy.
